On this walk you study an early Delhi Sultanate royal tomb and landscape.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Tomb entry viewpoint
  • Central crypt/outer areas when open
  • Ancillary remains
  • Approach landscape

How the time is spent

  1. Tomb entry viewpoint 15 min

    Contextualise early Sultanate funerary construction.

    You: chronology

  2. Central crypt/outer areas when open 30 min

    Examine plan and reused materials.

    You: sketch tomb plan

  3. Ancillary remains 30 min

    Review inscription traditions from reference images.

    You: observation worksheet

  4. Approach landscape 15 min

    Discuss preservation and urban surroundings.

    You: access review

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Identify and interpret key features of Sultan Ghari Tomb using material evidence and a site map.
  • Study an early Delhi Sultanate royal tomb and landscape.
  • Distinguish directly visible fabric from reconstructed or debated historical claims.

You take away

Your annotated field card, sketches and notes.
